title: Grade 3 Science — Thu, Jun 04
description: Animal Life — Day 4 of 5: Homes and young ones
subject: science

questions.question: Where does a bird usually live?
questions.explanation: Most birds build nests to live in and to lay their eggs.

questions.question: The home of a honeybee is called a:
questions.explanation: Honeybees live together in a hive.

questions.question: A spider makes a ____ to catch insects and live in.
questions.explanation: A spider spins a web to trap insects and as a place to live.

questions.question: The young one of a dog is called a:
questions.explanation: A baby dog is called a puppy.

questions.question: The young one of a cow is called a:
questions.explanation: A baby cow is called a calf.

questions.question: A rat or rabbit often lives in a hole in the ground called a:
questions.explanation: Animals like rats and rabbits dig and live in holes called burrows.

questions.question: The young one of a cat is called a:
questions.explanation: A baby cat is called a kitten.

questions.question: A baby bird that has just hatched is called a:
questions.explanation: A baby bird is called a chick.

questions.question: The home of a horse, built by people, is called a:
questions.explanation: Horses are kept in a stable.

questions.question: Animals that give birth to babies (not eggs) include:
questions.explanation: A cow gives birth to a live baby (calf). Hens, crows and sparrows lay eggs.

questions.question: The young one of a lion is called a:
questions.explanation: A baby lion is called a cub.

questions.question: Why do animals build homes or shelters?
options: To stay safe and protect their young
questions.explanation: Animals build shelters to stay safe from danger and the weather, and to protect their young.

questions.question: Which animal lays eggs?
questions.explanation: A hen lays eggs, from which chicks hatch.

questions.question: Match the home to the animal: a den is the home of a:
questions.explanation: Wild animals like lions live in a den.

questions.question: A mother hen sits on her eggs to keep them:
options: Warm so the chicks can grow
questions.explanation: A hen keeps her eggs warm so the baby chicks inside can grow and hatch.
